_comment: The story the board tells, one per match (picked by the match seed). Eight beats, drawn beside the path in order. 'pic' is a drawing BoardArt knows: house cake woods lake table grave door car tent well church factory clown bed. Add stories freely.

stories.title: GARY'S BIRTHDAY
beats: The cake is as big as Gary.
Hide and seek in the woods!
Gary's mum blows out the candles.

stories.title: THE FAMILY HOLIDAY
beats: There were four of them when they left.
The caravan park is very quiet.

stories.title: GRANDMA'S KITCHEN
beats: The vicar came to ask about it.
Grandma is a hundred and four.

stories.title: THE CIRCUS COMES TO TOWN
beats: The show was a great success.
The circus left in the night.
The volunteers' beds are still made.
The town is very tidy now.
